Can you confirm whether this should include your VP (Martin Blake) and/or Tom (CIO) in the main slot? If so, please pick one of the windows below (all PT):

If none of these work, tell us two 30-minute windows that do. I’m looping in Laura (AM) and Ben (SE) who will join to cover technical Qs. I’ll also include Vivek as our exec sponsor if you’d like an exchange between leadership.

Attached: deck-v1.pdf (30 slides, exec + demo notes).

Best,
